title: KeepInvStick
description: One-time item to keep inventory safe.
body:
[![AshCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a75887d69106ed9eb2dd595176121f279523f184_0.webp)](https://www.ashcraft.cz/)

KeepInvStick is a unique plugin that introduces a special consumable item designed to protect a player’s inventory upon death. When a player dies while carrying the item, the plugin automatically prevents their items from dropping, consumes the item, and ensures the inventory is safely preserved.

The item can be granted via the /givekeepinvstick command, which requires the permission node keepinvstick.give. By default, it is a diamond with a custom name and lore, but the concept is built to be expanded with customization support in the future.

Key features include:

One-time use protection – the item is removed from the inventory when activated on death.

Permission-based access (keepinvstick.give) for fair distribution.

Custom display name and lore for clear item identification.

Lightweight and efficient – integrates seamlessly into survival gameplay.

Built-in update checker and metrics for reliability.

Perfect for survival and adventure servers, KeepInvStick provides a balanced way to safeguard inventory without disabling death penalties entirely.
